sn22.108:1.1: Pañcime bhikkhave upādānakkhandhā || || Katame pañca || Seyyathīdaṃ rūpupādānakkhandho || pe || Viññāṇupādānakkhandho || || Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam na pajānanti || pe || pajānanti || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || || Sāvatthi || || Pañcime bhikkhave upādānakkhandhā
